newsitem.title: UK: EU green rates to devalue on Friday, HGCA.
newsitem.headline: EU green rates to devalue on Friday, HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Dutch Guilder, Danish crown, Spanish peseta, Portuguese escudo and Austrian schilling are to be devalued with effect from Friday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority said.

Also on Friday, the UK green rate will enter the fourth of a possible five confirmation periods ahead of a possible revaluation on August 21, the HGCA said. The new confirmation period will run from August 1 to 10.

The green Belgian franc will be devalued to 40.9321 per Ecu from the current rate of 40.8741. The green mark will be devalued to 1.98243 per Ecu (was 1.97970) and the green Guilder to 2.23273 per Ecu (2.22893).
The green Danish crown is to devalue to 7.54917 per Ecu from 7.54258.
The green Spanish peseta will devalue to 167.111 per Ecu from 166.839 and the green Portuguese escudo to 200.230 per Ecu from 199.837.
The green Austrian schilling will be devalued to 13.9485 per Ecu from 13.9291.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert amounts set in Ecus under its Common Agricultural Policy.
